messages:
jordan: Postmortem INC-2026-042 merged. Need owners for follow-ups: SLO retarget, dashboard alerts, autoscale/runbook, long-term GPU queue mitigation. Who can pick up?

maria: I9ll take dashboard + alert rules and the error-budget view. ETA EOW. :white_check_mark:

sam: I9ll handle the SLO/SLA wording and sync with product/legal. Draft by Tue next week.

lee: I can do autoscale + runbook edits. Need ~2w to implement plus staging dry run.

ankur: I9ll validate GPU queue pattern across past incidents and post findings. Tentative Fri.

ops-bot: INC-2026-042 archived: transient p95/p99 latency spike (~18m) from KVCACHE eviction during model warmup.

jordan: @maria include p50/p95/p99, req rate, queue depth, and error budget burn. Add a routing fallback (hosted -> dedicated) when burn is high.

maria: Proposed alert: if p95 > 250ms for 10m AND burn_rate > 1.5 -> page and open #runbook-INC-2026-042. Draft rule attached in PR.

sam: Recommend SLA clause: recovery window (p95 under threshold within 15m) + explicit fallback to dedicated at 80% burn. Will draft wording.

lee: Autoscale thresholds proposal: scale up if queue_depth >400 for 5m OR p95>220ms for 3m. Will add manual fallback steps.

jordan: Canonical action tracker: maria (dashboard/alerts) EOW; sam (SLO/SLA) Tue; lee (autoscale/runbook) 2w; ankur (gpu validation) Fri.

ankur: Running queries now. Will post heatmap and mitigation (shard balancing + backpressure limiter) in #eng-runtime by EOD Fri.

maria: Created dashboard PR: https://internal.redwood/dash/PR-789. Added tests and smoke checks.

sam: Product sync Wed 10:00 to align customer-facing SLA wording.

jordan: Quick 15min sync every Thu 09:00 until actions closed. I9ll update postmortem with owners and links. Use this thread for tracking. :spiral_calendar_pad:

lee: Will add a checklist in the runbook PR for on-call practice.

maria: Will wire up alert test harness and post results.

jordan: Closing loop. If anything slips, flag here and I9ll escalate.
